text: Maaku -an Nulaaɗo-: "Yettoore nden ko Alla woodani On hannduɗo e nooneeji gettooje ɗen, On Seniiɗo e gaayi ɓiɗɗo e kafidaaɗo, O maraa kafidaaɗo ka Laamu Makko, hoyre e lo'ere heɓataa Mo, O hatonnjinaa e walloowo Mo maa semmbinoowo Mo, Mawnin Mo Mawninngol ɗuuɗu ngol, wata a askinan Mo ɓiɗɗo maaɗun kafidaaɗo ka Laamu wanaa walloowo semmbinoowo.
